results.text: Failed Save: [[/damage 12d6 fire]] damage. Successful Save: Half as much damage. Additional Effects: Nonmagical ranged attacks can’t pass through this layer, which is destroyed if it takes at least 25 Cold damage.

Failed Save: [[/damage 12d6 acid]] damage. Successful Save: Half as much damage. Additional Effects: Magical ranged attacks can’t pass through this layer, which is destroyed by a strong wind (such as the one created by Gust of Wind).
Failed Save: [[/damage 12d6 lightning]] damage. Successful Save: Half as much damage. Additional Effects: The layer is destroyed if it takes at least 60 force damage.

Failed Save: [[/damage 12d6 poison]] damage. Successful Save: Half as much damage. Additional Effects: A Passwall spell, or another spell of equal or greater level that can open a portal on a solid surface, destroys this layer.
Failed Save: [[/damage 12d6 cold]] damage. Successful Save: Half as much damage. Additional Effects: The layer is destroyed if it takes at least 25 Fire damage.

Failed Save: The target has the &Reference[Restrained] condition and makes a [[/save con]] saving throw at the end of each of its turns. If it successfully saves three times, the condition ends. If it fails three times, it has the &Reference[Petrified] condition until it is freed by an effect like the Greater Restoration spell. The successes and failures needn’t be consecutive; keep track of both until the target collects three of a kind. Additional Effects: Spells can’t be cast through this layer, which is destroyed by Bright Light shed by the Daylight spell.

Failed Save: The target has the &Reference[Blinded] condition and makes a [[/save wis]] saving throw at the start of your next turn. On a successful save, the condition ends. On a failed save, the condition ends, and the creature teleports to another plane of existence (DM’s choice). Additional Effects: This layer is destroyed by Dispel Magic.
